primary_result: All 42 expected Haze4K outdoor source relationships are now resolved under the frozen relationship-first definition. Haze4K test 69 maps to already-excluded OTS 0354, Haze4K train 977 maps to already-excluded OTS 1964, and Haze4K train 937 maps to a geometrically coherent eight-member OTS source family containing 0230. Conservatively excluding all accepted family members produces an authorized 964-scene deduplicated exclusion union and leaves 8,006 eligible OTS scenes, above the frozen 6,000-scene capacity gate.
gate_reasons: The parent terminal, summary, mapping and 959-scene provisional exclusion identities matched exactly, including 39 previously verified new relationships and the three targeted parent diagnostic rows.
The qualified RESIDE identity, all 8,970 OTS clear scenes and all 4,000 Haze4K GT files matched the frozen dataset contract.
All three positive geometric controls passed and all three unrelated cross-pair negative controls were rejected.
Haze4K test 69 to OTS 0354 passed with 649 homography inliers among 652 reciprocal RootSIFT correspondences; Haze4K train 977 to OTS 1964 passed with 652 of 655.

Every member of the frozen top-eight Haze4K train 937 shortlist passed the geometric source rule; OTS 0230 ranked first with 512 homography inliers among 517 reciprocal correspondences. The eight members are treated as one source family and all excluded.
The corrected gate resolves 42 source relationships before deduplicating OTS IDs; it does not require each relationship to contribute a previously unseen OTS filename.
The final 964-scene exclusion union leaves 8,006 eligible OTS scenes and authorizes only a separately frozen outdoor measurement design.
competing_explanation: The prior apparent three-source shortfall was mostly an estimand error: two valid source relationships pointed to OTS IDs already excluded through other overlaps, while the third pointed to a family of near-duplicate OTS images. Local geometric evidence separates this explanation from matcher failure without privileging one filename inside the family.
limitations: This route qualifies source independence and capacity only; it does not validate an outdoor local-haze or restoration-demand measurement.
The eight train-937 OTS members are conservatively classified as one geometric source family; the route does not claim which filename is the canonical original.
ITS remains suitable as a mainstream indoor training source, but its failed q-recovery gate still blocks the previous indoor local-region measurement definition.
No model training, inference, checkpoint selection, dehazing outcome, confirmation, canary or locked-test metric was accessed.
